design: train+threshold frozen on development; evaluated once on unseen tasks/profiles/negative-families
limitations: Single held-out evaluation; negatives are deterministic automation, not live humans.
One calibration threshold per method, fixed on development negatives; test FPR resolution is limited by the number of confirmatory negatives.
Unseen axes are tasks, service profiles and script families; the lab, tool set and command budget are shared with development by design.
